svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Current against forward voltage for five diodes, each flat until it reaches its forward voltage and then rising steeply. At 20 milliamps: a Schottky about 0.23 volts, a silicon 1N4148 about 0.70, a red LED 1.85, a green LED 2.2 and a blue LED 3.3.
svg.text: Each diode has its own wall: the forward voltage
Modelled from datasheet points (Kingbright WP7113 LEDs, onsemi 1N4148 and 1N5817), 25 °C
